description: This file implements the MessageControl functionality within the WPEFramework plugin namespace, including a class for managing message control operations, threading, and message dispatching.

classes.name: MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class managing message unit settings, loading configuration on instantiation.

classes.name: MessageControlImplementation
classes.description: Implements message control interface, manages message dispatching, threading, and client interactions.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Core::Thread to run the dispatch loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: MessageControlImplementation
methods.description: Constructor initializing message client, thread, and settings.

methods.name: ~MessageControlImplementation
methods.description: Destructor stopping thread and cleaning up message client.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets or replaces the callback for message collection, managing thread state accordingly.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Adds an instance ID to the message client.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Removes an instance ID from the message client.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables specific message types, categories, and modules.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves current message control settings as an iterator.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Main message dispatch loop, waits for updates and calls the callback with message data.
